sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 251430, fetched 2026-10-20)

NPS alert 'Cape Point & Frisco campgrounds and several ORV ramps remain closed' (developer.nps.gov/api/v1/alerts?parkCode=caha, dated 2026-10-21, as read for results/applied/638.json; the API was rate-limited on 2026-10-22)

values.reopens: NPS: after post-storm assessments, no date announced; recreation.gov shows sites bookable again from 2026-10-24
values.note: NPS alert 2026-10-21: 'The Cape Point and Frisco campgrounds and several off-road vehicle routes are currently closed. Reopening will begin after conditions improve and post-storm assessments are complete.' recreation.gov marks every site Closed for the nights of Oct 16-23, 2026.

status.source: NPS alert 'Cape Point & Frisco campgrounds and several ORV ramps remain closed' (developer.nps.gov/api/v1/alerts?parkCode=caha, dated 2026-10-21) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/251430/month (Oct 2026: sites 'Closed' 10-16 to 10-23, 'Available' from 10-24), read 2026-10-22

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251430/rates (Peak Season 2026-04-03 to 2026-11-29 and 2027: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 28) + https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm (Frisco: Cost '$28'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251430 ('There are no RV hook ups in the campground') + https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm (Frisco 'Hook-ups? No'; 'There are currently no utility connections at the other three campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Outdoor unheated showers. Boardwalks to the beach; an ORV ramp at the entrance.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251430 ('modern restrooms with flushing toilets, potable water, and outdoor unheated showers'; 'Wooden boardwalks'; ORV ramp), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 127 sites (NPS); the catalog lists 112 standard, 10 RV and 2 tent-only sites, each with a paved pad, back-in or parallel, Max Vehicle Length mostly 31-45 ft. 'All equipment must fit on the site pad'; RVs over 25 ft may have to park a second vehicle in auxiliary parking or buy a second site. Sites sit among the dunes; few have shade.

sites.source: https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm (Frisco 'Sites 127'; 'Frisco Campground is located among sand dunes') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251430 (paved parking pad; 'large RVs over 25 feet may have to park second vehicles in auxiliary parking'; 'limited sites with shade') + RIDB catalog, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservation required, online at recreation.gov only; same-day bookings allowed by phone (877-444-6777) or smartphone, since rangers take no payment at the campground. 14 days at each campground from Easter Sunday to the Sunday after Thanksgiving.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251430 ('A reservation to camp is required. Same day reservations can be made based on availability'; 'Payment is only accepted through Recreation.gov'; maxStay 14 nights) + https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm ('Walk-ups (same day) reservations are permitted; however, campers will need to make payment online'; 'From Easter Sunday until the Sunday after Thanksgiving, all camping is limited to 14 days at each campground'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: NPS: 'Open Spring-Fall, check www.recreation.gov for dates'. The 2026 rate season ran April 3 - November 29.

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm (Frisco Availability 'Open Spring-Fall, check www.recreation.gov for dates'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251430 ('The Access Pass and both the Senior Annual and Senior Lifetime Pass are the only passes that provide a discount on the fee for the campsite physically occupied by the pass owner'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Currently CLOSED after a storm (NPS alert 2026-10-21; rec.gov closed Oct 16-23, bookable again from Oct 24). Confirmed $28 (2026) and no hookups. Added flush toilets/unheated showers/water, 127 sites (paved pads), reservation-only with same-day booking, 14-day Easter-Thanksgiving limit, spring-fall season, senior/access discount. Not stated: dump station at Frisco, booking window.
